description: This file exports various functions and types related to installation processes, including checking host versions, installing packages, scanning sources, and handling file paths.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at a given path.

methods.name: readJsonFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the specified path.

methods.name: resolveArchiveKind
methods.description: Resolves the kind of archive source.

methods.name: writeFileFromPathWithinRoot
methods.description: Writes data to a file within a specified root directory.

methods.name: resolveExistingInstallPath
methods.description: Resolves an existing installation path.

methods.name: withExtractedArchiveRoot
methods.description: Performs an operation with the extracted root of an archive.

methods.name: resolveInstallModeOptions
methods.description: Resolves installation mode options.

methods.name: resolveTimedInstallModeOptions
methods.description: Resolves timed installation mode options.

methods.name: installPackageDir
methods.description: Handles installation of a package directory.

methods.name: resolveArchiveSourcePath
methods.description: Resolves the source path of an archive.

methods.name: resolveCanonicalInstallTarget
methods.description: Resolves the canonical install target path.

methods.name: ensureInstallTargetAvailable
methods.description: Ensures the install target is available.

methods.name: finalizeNpmSpecArchiveInstall
methods.description: Finalizes installation from an NPM spec archive.

methods.name: installFromNpmSpecArchiveWithInstaller

methods.name: validateRegistryNpmSpec

methods.name: loadPluginManifest

methods.name: resolvePackageExtensionEntries
methods.description: Resolves package extension entries.

methods.name: checkMinHostVersion
methods.description: Checks minimum host version compatibility.

methods.name: isPathInside
methods.description: Checks if one path is inside another.

methods.name: detectBundleManifestFormat

methods.name: scanFileInstallSource
